summary: The blueprint is broadly plausible for healthy human pancreas but needs dendritic-cell coverage and a few marker refinements before it is publishable.

issues.description: The immune branch lacks a dendritic-cell module or gated axis, so pancreatic DCs would likely be absorbed into broad immune or macrophage/monocyte signals.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a dendritic-cell module and dendritic_cell_within_immune gated axis using canonical human DC markers such as FCER1A, CLEC10A, CD1C, CD1E, ITGAX, IRF8, FLT3, CLEC9A, XCR1, or LILRA4 as appropriate; include the new module as a negative sibling in the other immune subtype gated axes.

issues.description: The epsilon-cell module is only two genes and includes MLN, which is more characteristic of intestinal/gastric enteroendocrine motilin cells than canonical pancreatic epsilon cells.
issues.suggested_fix: Keep the epsilon axis only if supported by the pancreas literature, but make the module more pancreas-specific around GHRL and better-supported endocrine/epsilon-associated markers, or replace MLN with a pancreas-supported marker.

issues.description: The immune gate is partly driven by antigen-presentation genes that are strong in APC-rich populations but weak in many T and NK cells, which can bias immune-subtype gated axes.
issues.suggested_fix: Revise immune_core toward pan-leukocyte markers such as PTPRC, LCP1, CORO1A, ARHGAP15, FYB1, or ITGAL, and reserve HLA/CD74-heavy signal for APC subtype modules.

issues.description: SLC30A8 is reused from beta_cell and is more endocrine/beta-associated than PP/gamma-cell-specific, weakening the intended PP-vs-beta contrast.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace SLC30A8 in pp_cell with a better-supported PP/gamma marker from the cited pancreas atlases while retaining PPY and PYY.

out_of_scope: Paper and atlas DOI correctness was not re-verified because citation verification is outside this Discriminator scope.
